title: WNBA PRA Repair V1 Step 3 — Page 3 Data Completeness
reason_for_component_freeze: User explicitly skipped the unresolved Step-2 public Page-2 navigation proof. Step 3 therefore freezes the Page-3 data-completeness component independently and does not falsely claim the public route is end-to-end green.
root_causes: Opponent identity on Page 3 was coupled to an exact qualified consumer-card match even though selected-game truth already contained both teams.
The frozen Game Center role row carried L5/L10 production and usage evidence but dropped it before the selected-player snapshot reached Page 3.
The frozen Page-3 presentation hardcoded pace and usage placeholders instead of exposing existing PRA V3.6 pace context and role-engine usage evidence.
H2H matching received no opponent key whenever consumer qualification was absent.
patch: Composable Step-3 overlay above the merged Step-2 team-identity runtime. Preserve role-row L5/L10 and usage fields, derive opponent from selected-game truth, backfill recent aggregate form from verified role-row values, reuse PRA V3.6 pace context, and pass canonical opponent identity into history/H2H matching.
